\section*{Question 1}

A particle moving along a curve in the plane has position \((x(t), y(t))\) at time \(t\), where
\[
\frac{d x}{d t}=\sqrt{t^{4}+9} \text { and } \frac{d y}{d t}=2 e^{t}+5 e^{-t}
\]
for all real values of \(t\). At time \(t=0\), the particle is at the point ( 4,1 ).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the speed of the particle and its acceleration vector at time \(t=0\).
\item[(b)] Find an equation of the line tangent to the path of the particle at time \(t=0\).
\item[(c)] Find the total distance traveled by the particle over the time interval \(0 \leq t \leq 3\).
\item[(d)] Find the \(x\)-coordinate of the position of the particle at time \(t=3\).
\item[(a)] At time \(t=0\) :
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \text { Speed }=\sqrt{x^{\prime}(0)^{2}+y^{\prime}(0)^{2}}=\sqrt{3^{2}+7^{2}}=\sqrt{58} \\
& \text { Acceleration vector }=\left\langle x^{\prime \prime}(0), y^{\prime \prime}(0)\right\rangle=\langle 0,-3\rangle
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)] \(\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{y^{\prime}(0)}{x^{\prime}(0)}=\frac{7}{3}\)
Tangent line is \(y=\frac{7}{3}(x-4)+1\)
\item[(c)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Distance } & =\int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{\left(\sqrt{t^{4}+9}\right)^{2}+\left(2 e^{t}+5 e^{-t}\right)^{2}} d t \\
& =45.226 \text { or } 45.227
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
x(3) & =4+\int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{t^{4}+9} d t \\
& =17.930 \text { or } 17.931
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { speed } \\ 1: \text { acceleration vector }\end{array}\right.\)
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { slope } \\ 1: \text { tangent line }\end{array}\right.\)
\(3:\left\{\begin{aligned} 2: & \text { distance integral } \\ & \langle-1\rangle \text { each integrand error } \\ & \langle-1\rangle \text { error in limits } \\ & 1: \text { answer }\end{aligned}\right.\)
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integral } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
